referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Fallsbrook Motors website in London, England uses garage and service imagery beneath a strong navy-and-yellow booking header. Navigation is phone and email utility with a prominent online-booking control. Its page moves through service opening, booking form, service grid, shop capability explanation, trust and accreditation panel, testimonials, contact close, with named maintenance and repair jobs with clear detail links. garage and vehicle imagery in functional rectangular crops. Transferable mechanics are yellow booking accent, service-and-form pairing, navy reassurance band. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
